description: Designed and developed a full service management system, automating manual registration and reducing processing times.
Built responsive user interfaces with React and Bootstrap, improving user experience and reducing interaction errors.
Implemented automated testing with Selenium, increasing QA coverage and ensuring production stability.
Managed Firebase NoSQL database, handling client data, employee records and repair workflows.
Designed and evaluated accessible, user-centered web applications including serious games and telerehabilitation platforms.
Conducted usability evaluations using SUS and CSUQ frameworks, delivering actionable UX improvement recommendations.
Co-authored 13 peer-reviewed publications in indexed journals (Q1–Q3) on serious games, usability, and inclusive technologies.
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams across UDLA, EPN, and PUCE on CEDIA-funded research projects.
Led a multidisciplinary team in planning and digital outreach for the Digital Inclusion and Future Programmers initiatives.
Established strategic partnerships with high-impact organizations, improving program visibility and sustainability.
Planned and executed educational activities that strengthened digital competencies across beneficiary communities.
